about: GDP figures for countries and territories the World Bank has none for, each from the source named. Values are US dollars; a figure published in another currency is converted at about that year's average exchange rate, and the entry says so. tools/gdp.mjs reads this file.
note: France's World Bank figure includes its five overseas departments (RE, GP, MQ, GF, YT) and Finland's includes Åland (AX). They are on the map on their own as well, so about 0.05% of the world's GDP is counted twice.

TW.source: DGBAS (Taiwan's statistics office): GDP per person of US$39,477 in 2025, times the population

KP.source: Bank of Korea estimate of North Korea's nominal gross national income: 44.4 trillion won

RE.source: INSEE: 23.2 billion euros, at 1.08 US$ to the euro

GP.source: IEDOM: about 10.4 billion euros, at 1.08 US$ to the euro

MQ.source: IEDOM: about 10.1 billion euros, at 1.08 US$ to the euro

GF.source: IEDOM: about 5.0 billion euros, at 1.08 US$ to the euro

YT.source: IEDOM: 3.1 billion euros, at 1.18 US$ to the euro

JE.source: World Bank figure for the Channel Islands (12.51 billion US$), shared by the islands' own GDP: Jersey 6,575 and Guernsey 3,488 million pounds
